title.narrative: Ukraine EUAM Blue Havens and MHPSS for law enforcement agencies (NPU, NGU, SESU and NBGU)

description.narrative:
Note: The current appraisal document serves to justify a top-up on an ongoing program. The top-up is funded with "Algemene Middelen" (MinFin). The appraisal is registered in IMPACT as a separate activity because since 2025 separate "budgetplaatsen" are foreseen for Ukraine-specific funding. In order to let this contribution land on the correct "budgetplaats" (art 5.3 Legitimate stability, Ukraine), the activity needs to be entered separately. Externally, however, the additional commitment will be realized with an amendment to the previous arrangement. The appraisal in this document is partly copied from the original appraisal document, updated and adapted where applicable.
The core objective of the proposal for Phase 2 is to solidify results of Phase 1, which was aimed at the National Police of Ukraine (NPU), and to broaden the scope and work also with the National Guard (NGU), the State Border Guard Service (SBGS) and the State Emergency Service (SESU) of Ukraine. The Program aims to increase the capabilities of these four law enforcement and emergency services, the program to offer quality mental and psychosocial support as part of the duty of care for NPU-staff, and to increase the accessibility of such care. This will strengthen the resilience of NPU, NGU, SBGS and SESU, will help retain more staff notwithstanding the high mental load of their work and reduce a.o. domestic violence in families of staff, and it will contribute to a rights-based performance by these services. This will in its turn contribute to community safety and trust of population in law enforcement and emergency agencies.
